name: LLM Structured Output Compliance Tester
description: Tests all locally available LLM models on their ability to produce valid structured output (JSON). Each phase tests one model, with a final documentation phase generating a compliance report.

_phases.name: Test: DistilGPT2 (baseline)
_phases.description: Baseline test - text-gen only model, expected low compliance

_phases.name: Test: DeepSeek Coder 1.3B
_phases.description: Code-focused model - should handle JSON well

_phases.name: Test: SmolLM2 1.7B
_phases.description: Medium instruct model - better instruction following

_phases.name: Phase 6: Documentation
_phases.description: Generate compliance report from all test results

llm.systemPrompt: You are a technical documentation writer. Generate a Markdown compliance report. Output ONLY valid Markdown. No JSON, no code fences around the entire output.
llm.userPromptTemplate:
Generate a Markdown compliance report for LLM structured output testing.

Phase Results:
{{_phases}}

Detailed Metrics (per-model timing, tokens, fitness):
{{_phaseMetrics}}

For each model tested, include:
- Model name and ID
- Compliance score and pass/fail
- Cold start vs warm start timing
- Token usage (prompt + completion)
- Key observations

End with a recommendation section listing which models are suitable for structured output tasks.

Format as clean Markdown with headers, tables, and bullet points.
